# PulseKit — 18 Free In-Browser Hardware & Web Tools (100% Client-Side, Zero Uploads)

> PulseKit is a zero-upload, privacy-first browser utility and hardware diagnostics lab. Every tool executes locally inside the user's device memory using HTML5 Canvas, PDF-Lib, Tesseract WASM, Web Audio API, Web Gamepad API, and Web Crypto API.

## Main Site
- https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/ (English & Spanish toggle)
- https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/herramientas-web-gratis-espanol (Dedicated Spanish / Mexico / Latam landing page)

## 18 Dedicated Tool Endpoints
1. Image Compressor & WebP Converter: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/image-compressor-webp-converter
2. PS5 DualSense, PS4 & Xbox Stick Drift Tester: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/controller-drift-tester-ps5-xbox
3. Mouse Polling Rate (Hz), CPS & Reaction Time Test: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/mouse-polling-rate-cps-reaction-test
4. Online Microphone Visualizer & Dead Pixel Screen Test: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/mic-dead-pixel-screen-test
5. Headphone & Speaker Stereo L/R + Sub-Bass Tester: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/speaker-headphone-bass-tester
6. Image Color Palette Extractor (HEX) & WCAG Contrast: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/color-palette-extractor-contrast
7. Instant QR Code & Wi-Fi Share Generator: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/qr-code-wifi-generator
8. Keyboard Ghosting, NKRO & Switch Chatter Tester: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/keyboard-ghosting-nkro-chatter-test
9. PDF Merger & Image-to-PDF Studio: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/merge-pdf-image-to-pdf-free
10. Photo EXIF Metadata Viewer & GPS Privacy Stripper: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/remove-exif-gps-data-from-photos
11. Monitor Refresh Rate (Hz) & Frame-Skip Motion Test: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/monitor-refresh-rate-hz-fps-test
12. Image-to-Text OCR Extractor (English & Spanish): https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/image-to-text-ocr-online-free
13. JSON Formatter, Validator & Base64 Encoder/Decoder: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/json-formatter-base64-decoder-online
14. Text & Code Diff Checker: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/text-code-diff-checker-online
15. SHA-256 / SHA-512 / SHA-1 File & Text Checksum: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/sha256-file-checksum-hash-generator
16. Mbps to MB/s Download Time, PX/REM & 16:9 Calculator: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/internet-speed-aspect-ratio-calculator
17. Pomodoro Focus Timer & Brown/Pink/White Noise: https://pulsekit-tools.vercel.app/pomodoro-timer-brown-noise-online

## Privacy & Architecture
- Zero server uploads: 0 bytes of user files, audio, or credentials leave the browser.
- Free forever, no account required, mobile and desktop responsive.
